title: Performance of intracortical microelectrode arrays in people with implanted brain–computer interfaces over a 20-year period
zh_title: 植入式脑机接口Utah阵列20年性能评估
summary: BrainGate临床试验20年数据评估Utah微电极阵列的长期记录与解码稳定性。
key_points: 涵盖2289次记录、20个阵列、14名参与者
平均35.6%电极可记录到神经脉冲，7年余下降约7个百分点
14个阵列中11个全程保持有效运动解码
reason: 20年多阵列大样本长期随访，含解码稳定性外部量化，属重要档
abstract: The silicon microelectrode ‘Utah’ array has enabled people with paralysis to control computer cursors, operate prosthetic limbs and communicate using high-performance brain–computer interfaces. However, reports so far have typically been limited to one or two individuals, with no systematic assessment of array longevity, decoding accuracy and day-to-day stability. Here we present a comprehensive 20-year evaluation of neural data from the BrainGate clinical trials, spanning 2,289 recording sessions, 20 arrays and 14 participants. On average, arrays successfully recorded neural spiking waveforms on 35.6% of electrodes, with a modest 7 percentage point decline over the recording period (up to 7.3 years). Using a ‘decoding signal-to-noise ratio’ (dSNR) metric, we found that 11 of 14 arrays provided meaningful movement decoding throughout participation (median dSNR >1), with three achieving >70% accuracy compared with able-bodied mouse control. We also found that dSNR increased approximately logarithmically with the number of electrodes, providing a pathway for scaling performance. While longevity exceeded previous nonhuman primate studies, achieving peak performance consistently may require further improvements.
zh_abstract: 硅微电极“Utah”阵列已使瘫痪患者能够控制计算机光标、操作假肢，并使用高性能脑机接口进行交流。然而，迄今的报道通常仅限于一两个人，且未对阵列寿命、解码准确性和逐日稳定性进行系统评估。在此，我们呈现对BrainGate临床试验神经数据的全面20年评估，涵盖2,289次记录会话、20个阵列和14名参与者。平均而言，阵列在35.6%的电极上成功记录到神经尖峰波形，在记录期内（最长7.3年）出现适度下降，降幅为7个百分点。使用“解码信噪比”（dSNR）指标，我们发现14个阵列中有11个在整个参与期间提供了有意义的运动解码（中位dSNR >1），其中3个达到>70%的准确率（与健全个体使用鼠标控制相比）。我们还发现，dSNR随电极数量近似对数增加，为性能扩展提供了路径。尽管其使用寿命超过了既往非人灵长类研究，但要持续达到峰值性能可能仍需进一步改进。

title: Artificial intelligence capacity in the rural United States: a national qualitative study.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 美国农村医院AI应用能力的全国质性研究
summary: 对全美50家关键通道医院73名管理者的访谈，考察农村医院如何使用AI及安全有效应用的障碍。
key_points: 分层随机抽样覆盖全美四区域关键通道医院
访谈50家医院73名技术决策者
聚焦生成式AI应用与安全使用障碍
reason: 全国分层抽样质性研究，揭示农村部署障碍与公平议题，但无结局指标，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To understand how rural hospitals use artificial intelligence (AI) and identify ways to reduce the barriers to safe, effective use of high-quality tools that align with these hospitals' key priorities. Stratified random sample drawn from the full population of critical access hospitals (CAHs) in the United States in 2025 (n = 1377) to approximate proportional representation of the 4 census regions. We conducted in-depth qualitative interviews with hospital leadership (eg, CMIOs, CIOs, IT leads) tasked with decision-making about technology. Interviews were conducted between October 20, 2025, and January 23, 2026. Drawn from the full population of CAHs in the US in 2025, 256 hospitals were sampled and interviews were completed for a total of 50 CAHs represented by 73 interview participants. Generative AI applications were more common and seen as more valuable for CAH contexts than traditional predictive AI. Primary barriers included infrastructure limitations, cost, and lack of transparency on how AI tools worked. Despite a desire to implement robust governance, most CAHs did not have the ability to do so and reported a critical need for information, tools, and policies to build their AI governance capacity. Information (peer learning, information from non-commercial sources), tools (registries, model cards), and policy to support technical capacity were perceived as the most responsive ways to build capacity. To reduce structural barriers to safe and effective AI decision-making, resources and investment should focus on information sharing with and across rural organizations, AI governance support, and transparency efforts. This will support CAHs in judiciously leveraging available resources and prevent waste on low-quality or misaligned AI tools.
zh_abstract: 《美国医学信息学协会会刊：JAMIA》 旨在了解农村医院如何使用人工智能（AI），并识别减少障碍的方法，以促进安全、有效地使用与这些医院关键优先事项相一致的高质量工具。从2025年美国全部关键接入医院（critical access hospitals, CAHs）总体（n = 1377）中抽取分层随机样本，以近似按比例代表4个人口普查区域。我们对负责技术决策的医院领导层（如CMIO、CIO、IT负责人）进行了深入定性访谈。访谈于2025年10月20日至2026年1月23日进行。从2025年美国CAHs全总体中抽取256家医院，最终完成访谈，共代表50家CAHs，由73名访谈参与者代表。在CAH情境中，生成式AI应用比传统预测性AI更常见，也被认为更有价值。主要障碍包括基础设施限制、成本，以及AI工具运作方式缺乏透明度。尽管有意实施稳健治理，大多数CAHs没有能力这样做，并报告亟需信息、工具和政策来建设其AI治理能力。信息（同行学习、来自非商业来源的信息）、工具（登记库、模型卡）以及支持技术能力的政策，被认为是建设能力最切合需求的方式。为减少安全有效AI决策的结构性障碍，资源和投资应聚焦于与农村组织共享信息及农村组织之间的信息共享、AI治理支持和透明度工作。这将支持CAHs审慎利用可用资源，并防止在低质量或不匹配的AI工具上造成浪费。

title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
zh_title: AI分析ICU入院胸部CT体成分与6月死亡率
summary: 单中心前瞻队列用开源AI分割胸CT体成分，构建评分关联ICU患者6月生存。
key_points: 509例中475例纳入最终分析
体成分风险评分与6月生存显著相关
交叉验证AUC 0.73，嵌套校正后0.68
reason: 单中心前瞻队列但仅内部交叉验证，预后指标无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival (p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房（ICU）入院时异常的身体组成与更差的生存相关，但在实践中很少被测量，因为手动CT分析劳动强度大。我们对一个单中心前瞻性队列进行了二次分析，该队列包含509名在ICU入院后24小时内接受胸部CT的患者，其中475名被纳入最终分析。使用开源AI分割来量化身体组成，并将所得特征与6个月生存相关。由身体组成得出的风险评分与6个月生存显著相关（p < 0.001，log-rank检验）。在五折交叉验证中，区分生存者与非生存者的AUC为0.73；当考虑特征选择时，通过嵌套交叉验证得到的AUC为0.68，通过bootstrap乐观校正得到的AUC为0.69。该研究表明，基于AI的入院胸部CT自动化分析产生的身体组成评分与ICU入院后6个月死亡率显著相关。

title: Social work informatics: an equity framework for health informatics.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 社会工作信息学：健康信息学公平框架
summary: JAMIA提出社会工作信息学公平框架，主张社工参与健康信息学治理与AI系统设计。
key_points: 框架基于社工、信息学与健康公平文献综述
提出6个域：共同设计、SDOH数据整合等
强调AI输出的情境解释与社区领导
reason: 框架类观点文章，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Social work informatics (SWI) was proposed as a professional specialty in 2006, yet social work remains under-represented in health informatics governance, research, and system design even as artificial intelligence (AI) shapes high-stakes clinical decisions. This paper introduces the SWI Equity Framework, positioning social work as a leader in designing equitable health informatics systems. The framework was developed through a synthesis of social work, health informatics, and health equity literature. The framework identifies 6 domains: reflexive system co-design, social determinants of health data integration, training-data quality and representation, contextual interpretation of AI outputs, community leadership, and equitable accountability. The framework highlights opportunities to integrate social work expertise throughout the health informatics lifecycle, moving beyond consultation toward active participation in system design, implementation, and governance. It also outlines pathways for advancing social work informatics through education, interdisciplinary research, health systems, and professional infrastructure. Social work is particularly well positioned to advance the equity agenda of health informatics and offers profession-specific expertise that can strengthen equity, accountability, and implementation across the informatics lifecycle.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 社会工作信息学（SWI）于2006年被提出作为一个专业方向，然而即便人工智能（AI）正在塑造高利害临床决策，社会工作在健康信息学治理、研究和系统设计中的代表性仍然不足。本文介绍SWI公平框架，将社会工作定位为设计公平健康信息学系统的领导者。该框架通过综合社会工作、健康信息学和健康公平文献而制定。该框架确定了6个领域：反思性系统共同设计、健康社会决定因素的数据整合、训练数据质量与代表性、AI输出的情境化解读、社区领导以及公平问责。该框架强调了在整个健康信息学生命周期中整合社会工作专业知识的机会，从咨询转向积极参与系统设计、实施和治理。它还概述了通过教育、跨学科研究、卫生系统和专业基础设施推进社会工作信息学的路径。社会工作尤其适合推进健康信息学的公平议程，并提供专业特有的专业知识，可增强整个信息学生命周期中的公平、问责和实施。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Multidisciplinary Tumor Board for Prostate Cancer: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI在前列腺癌多学科肿瘤委员会的应用综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI作为MDT输入（MRI读片、Gleason分级等）与决策支持两种角色。
key_points: 深度学习MRI读片达或超放射科医师水平
规则型工具复现标准建议86-99%
通用大模型与真实泌尿肿瘤board一致率56-93%
reason: 叙述性综述，汇总已有证据但无新数据，按综述上限评档
abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Multidisciplinary tumor boards (MDTs) guide prostate cancer decisions but are strained by rising case volumes, evolving guidelines, and growing complexity. Artificial intelligence (AI) now enters the MDT at two levels. First, it generates inputs: deep-learning magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reading matches or exceeds radiologists' performance in the Prostate Imaging-Cancer Artificial Intelligence (PI-CAI) study; Gleason grading reaches expert-level agreement; PSMA PET quantification is automated; and multimodal pathology biomarkers predict ADT benefit. Second, decision-support systems act on MDT output: rule-based tools reproduce standard recommendations in 86-99% of cases, mostly in populations dominated by standard cases, whereas general-purpose large language models (LLMs) agree with real urological boards in 56-93% of cases, depending largely on input quality and case mix, and perform worse in metastatic disease; agreement does not establish clinical benefit. Of 33 appraised decision-support studies, 27 were at high risk of bias, 20 of them solely because the treating board served as an unblinded reference standard; explainability, regulation, and automation bias remain unresolved. We propose that AI currently serves as a supervised pre-reader, guideline checker, and triage tool. Prospective multicenter studies with patient outcomes are needed.
zh_abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] 多学科肿瘤委员会（MDT）指导前列腺癌决策，但受病例量上升、指南不断演变和复杂性日益增加所制约。人工智能（AI）现在在两个层面进入MDT。首先，它生成输入：在前列腺影像-癌症人工智能（PI-CAI）研究中，深度学习磁共振成像（MRI）阅片达到或超过放射科医师的表现；Gleason分级达到专家级一致性；PSMA PET定量实现自动化；多模态病理生物标志物可预测ADT获益。其次，决策支持系统作用于MDT输出：基于规则的工具在86-99%的病例中重现标准建议，且主要是在以标准病例为主的人群中；而通用大语言模型（LLMs）在56-93%的病例中与真实泌尿外科肿瘤委员会一致，这很大程度上取决于输入质量和病例构成，并且在转移性疾病中表现更差；一致性并不能确立临床获益。在33项被评价的决策支持研究中，27项存在高偏倚风险，其中20项仅因为治疗委员会作为非盲参考标准；可解释性、监管和自动化偏倚仍未解决。我们提出，AI目前作为受监督的预读工具、指南核查工具和分诊工具。需要开展以患者结局为终点、前瞻性多中心研究。

title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
zh_title: JHealthBench-L：日本本土化医学大模型评分基准
summary: arXiv预印本发布经医师评审的日本本土化HealthBench-L，含79例咨询、1022条评分标准。
key_points: 79例面向患者的咨询，1022条评分标准
专家仅需完全重写4.4%的评分标准
93.6%二阶段标准经独立双医师审核通过
reason: 新发布的经临床医生评审的评测基准，但规模中等且为预印本
abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.
zh_abstract: 诸如 HealthBench 这类基于评分细则的基准，使用病例特定的医生标准来评估大型语言模型（LLM）在开放式健康咨询中的表现，而其中许多标准预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和照护路径。仅靠机器翻译时，这些地区性假设仍留在评分细则中，使在日本恰当的应答在外国临床规则下不被计分或被错误扣分。为在不从零编写评分细则的情况下，将既有临床评估视角适配到日本，我们通过带来源引用的 LLM 起草、单一专科医生筛选与修订、独立双医师审核以及元审核，构建了 JHealthBench-L（79 项面向患者的咨询，1,022 条标准）。专科医生仅从头改写了 4.4% 的标准，独立审核者无问题地批准了 93.6% 的第二阶段标准。在 18 个 LLM 上比较 JHealthBench-L 与机器翻译基线显示，仅翻译评估保留了粗粒度模型排名（$τ= 0.817$，平均偏移 +0.027），却对 17.7% 的修改标准翻转了判定（相比之下重新评分的噪声为 7.3%），并将对日本适配阴性标准的错误扣分减少了 7.1 个百分点，从而在稳定排行榜背后掩盖了条目级临床误测。轴级和配对分析进一步表明，上下文感知和日本特定临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练和推理后训练显著提升了本地化落地性能。数据集、医生修订日志和评估代码可在 https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L 获取。

title: AI-Assisted Adaptive Support to Reduce Post-Intensive Care Syndrome-Family
summary: 三中心RCT注册，拟纳入1000名ICU患者家属，评估AI辅助手机应用能否减轻PICS-F症状。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Baqiyatallah Medical Sciences University; conditions: Post-Intensive Care Syndrome-Family (PICS-F), Post-Traumatic Stress, Psychological Distress; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The ASSIST trial evaluates whether an AI-assisted smartphone application can reduce post-traumatic stress symptoms and other psychological distress in family members of critically ill patients. Admission to an intensive care unit (ICU) places a severe psychological burden on families, often leading to post-intensive care syndrome-family (PICS-F). Current support is mostly reactive and rarely available after the patient is discharged. This study is a three-center randomized controlled trial involving 1000 family members. Participants will be randomly assigned to receive either standard care or standard care plus the ASSIST smartphone platform. During the ICU stay, the platform uses an artificial intelligence model to simplify clinical information (approved by a clinician) and helps families prepare questions for the medical team. After the patient is discharged, the platform monitors the family member's mood daily. If a risk of anxiety or depression is detected, it provides a brief digital cognitive behavioral therapy module. The main goal is to see if the ASSIST platform reduces post-traumatic stress over a 12-month period compared to standard care alone. Secondary goals include evaluating its effects on acute stress, decisional conflict, anxiety, depression, and caregiver burden. The study will also include qualitative interviews to understand the family members' lived experiences using the platform

title: Separating Measurement Failures from Defence Failures in Split Language-Model Privacy
zh_title: 拆分语言模型隐私评估的测量失败与防御失败
summary: 对拆分训练LLM隐私评估做回溯性再分析，区分测量无效与真实隐私泄露。
key_points: 跨四个拆分LLM实验再分析既有隐私主张
24项必要探测中仅4项合格
4项校准探测在13个配置中确认隐私泄露
reason: 与医疗场景无关的LLM隐私方法学预印本，应用关联弱
abstract: Split-training privacy evaluations fail through distinct mechanisms. Evaluators can overlook an exposed gradient channel, align reconstructions against shifted labels, or deploy uncalibrated probes before testing a candidate defence, while calibrated attacks can also refute real defences. Separating these failure modes alters which claims survive. We conduct a retrospective evidentiary reanalysis across four split-LLM campaigns and two cross-cutting scope checks covering host key custody and variational mutual-information bounds, mapping every recorded claim to one of five admissibility states (breach, non-detection, undetermined coverage, invalid measurement, or out-of-scope inference). Across a 19-configuration exploration, only four of 24 required probes qualified, yet those four calibrated probes still established qualified privacy breaches in 13 configurations, while utility or learning-gain failures eliminated the remaining 6. In a seven-cell defence-redesign pilot, 2 quantised configurations failed utility gates, calibrated next-byte structure probes breached the 0.02 gate on all 7 cells (0.097 to 0.112), and qualified punctuation-property probes reached 0.79 to 0.89, yielding 4 failed and 3 undetermined composite privacy assessments (the latter from marginal null-band excursions on punctuation bindings). Negative evidence against both defence families remains intact. Scope checks further show that shared-key orthogonal wrappers protect passive network captures without hiding activations from a compromised restoring host, and why near-zero variational lower bounds leave worst-case leakage unconstrained. Rerunnable scripts verify 1,522 checks across 122 SHA-256-pinned artifacts while preserving each campaign's native seed intervals and retrospective boundaries.
zh_abstract: 拆分训练隐私评估会通过不同机制失败。评估者可能忽略暴露的梯度通道、将重建结果与偏移后的标签对齐，或在测试候选防御之前部署未校准探针，而校准后的攻击也可能驳倒真实防御。将这些失败模式区分开来会改变哪些主张能够成立。我们对四项拆分 LLM（split-LLM）活动及两项跨领域范围检查（涵盖主机密钥保管与变分互信息界）进行了回顾性证据再分析，将每一项记录在案的主张映射到五种可采纳性状态之一（泄露、未检测到、覆盖范围未确定、测量无效或超出范围推断）。在 19 种配置的探索中，24 个所需探针中只有 4 个合格，但这 4 个校准探针仍在 13 种配置中确立了合格的隐私泄露，而效用或学习增益失败消除了其余 6 项。在一项七单元防御重新设计试点中，2 个量化配置未通过效用门槛，校准的下一字节结构探针在所有 7 个单元上突破 0.02 门槛（0.097 至 0.112），合格的标点属性探针达到 0.79 至 0.89，最终得到 4 项失败和 3 项未确定的综合隐私评估（后者源于标点绑定上的边缘零假设带偏移）。针对两类防御的负面证据仍然成立。范围检查进一步表明，共享密钥正交包装器可保护被动网络抓包，却不会向受损的恢复主机隐藏激活值，并说明为何接近零的变分下界无法约束最坏情况泄露。可重复运行的脚本在保留每项活动的原生种子区间和回顾性边界的同时，验证了 122 个以 SHA-256 固定的工件中的 1,522 项检查。

title: What Does an Agent-Run Clinic Cost? Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study of the Compute Cost of Completed Work in a Clinical Agent Fleet
zh_title: 临床智能体集群「完成工作的算力成本」研究方案

abstract: Background: Decisions about deploying large language model (LLM) agents in health care require the cost of completed work in production. Published evidence reports benchmark accuracy, benchmark-level cost, and time or financial outcomes for ambient documentation, and list prices alone do not determine the cost of completed work. To our knowledge, no deployed clinical agent fleet has published a measurement method that ties compute cost, latency, failures and retries to completed work. Objective: This study aims to estimate the compute cost of completed work by the orchestrated clinical agents of a deployed LLM agent fleet over a 12-week window of production telemetry, using estimators, data-quality gates and an analysis plan fixed before any window data are extracted for the study. Methods: The setting is a private outpatient clinic in London, United Kingdom, where wai, a multi-agent system supporting clinic operations, is deployed. The population is every run of the 20 orchestrated clinical documentation and decision-support agents starting between September 21 and December 13, 2026. The run store writes 2 records for every run, a non-terminal record before the model call and a terminal record after it, and has no attempt counter or parent-run link. Estimators defined on that structure cover cost per resolved execution and per completed intention, retry and failed-intention shares of compute, error and failure rates, latency, cost per draft offered for clinician review and a latency-cost frontier, by agent, task class and acceptance stratum. Cost is recorded in GBP pence, converted from provider-returned US dollar cost at a fixed rate and rounded per model call. The plan fixes weekly aggregation, small-cell suppression, bootstrap intervals over weeks, 2 prespecified comparisons, 5 sensitivity analyses and 4 data-quality gates whose failure converts an estimate into a bound or an unmeasured stratum. Two staff-level measures proposed during planning were dropped. Revenue, pricing, margin and staffing inference are excluded. Results: The measurement window opened on September 21, 2026, and closes on December 13, 2026, and telemetry is being recorded in routine operation. No window data had been extracted for this study at submission. Aggregate whole-table counts that include window records were extracted on November 19, 2026, for companion manuscripts and are disclosed. zh_abstract: 【背景】在医疗保健中部署大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的决策需要了解生产环境中已完成工作的成本。已发表证据报告了基准准确性、基准层面成本以及环境文档的时间或财务结果，而仅凭标价并不能决定已完成工作的成本。据我们所知，尚无已部署的临床智能体集群发表过将计算成本、延迟、失败和重试与已完成工作联系起来的测量方法。【目的】本研究旨在利用估计量、数据质量门槛以及在任何研究窗口数据提取前即固定的分析计划，估计一个已部署 LLM 智能体集群的编排临床智能体在 12 周生产遥测窗口内完成工作的计算成本。【方法】研究场景为英国伦敦一家私立门诊诊所，其中部署了支持诊所运营的多智能体系统 wai。研究总体为 2026 年 9 月 21 日至 12 月 13 日之间启动的 20 个编排临床文档与决策支持智能体的每一次运行。运行存储为每次运行写入 2 条记录：模型调用前的非终态记录和模型调用后的终态记录，且没有尝试计数器或父运行链接。基于该结构定义的估计量涵盖：按智能体、任务类别和接受层级划分的每次已解决执行成本和每次已完成意图成本、重试与失败意图在计算中所占份额、错误率与失败率、延迟、每份提交临床医生审阅的草稿成本以及延迟-成本前沿。成本以英镑便士记录，按固定汇率从提供商返回的美元成本换算，并按每次模型调用四舍五入。该计划固定了按周聚合、小单元格抑制、按周自举区间、2 项预设比较、5 项敏感性分析和 4 项数据质量门槛；门槛失败会将估计值转换为界限或未测量层。规划期间提出的两项员工层面指标被删除。收入、定价、利润率和人员配置推断被排除。【结果】测量窗口于 2026 年 9 月 21 日开启，于 2026 年 12 月 13 日关闭，遥测正在常规运行中记录。提交时尚未为本研究提取任何窗口数据。包含窗口记录的整表汇总计数已于 2026 年 11 月 19 日提取用于配套论文，并予以披露。提取将不早于 2026 年 12 月 15 日开始，结果预计将
